attackers_goals: Execute commands within the Kubernetes Pod. Access any resource the Kubernetes Pod has access to.
description: An identity initiated a shell session within a Kubernetes pod using the exec command. The command allows an identity to establish a temporary shell session and execute commands in the pod. This may indicate an attacker attempting to gain an interactive shell, which will allow access to the pod's data.
investigative_actions: Check the identity's role designation in the organization. Inspect for any additional suspicious activities inside the Kubernetes Pod.
